prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: back strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1089; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact at intersection. Insured reports vehicle struck on driver side by third-party vehicle that failed to yield at signalized intersection. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles on file. Claimant reports back strain and has retained counsel. All further contact to go through attorney's office.

Entry 2: Received letter of representation from claimant's attorney. Liability disputed in part; third party's insurer has acknowledged partial fault. Reviewing signal timing data and witness statement. Requested medical authorization and prior records through counsel.

Entry 3: Medical records received showing diagnosis of lumbar strain with muscle spasm. Treating physician recommends physical therapy twice weekly for six weeks. No fractures or imaging abnormalities noted. Flagged file for bodily injury evaluation pending completion of treatment.

Entry 4: Spoke with claimant's attorney regarding demand package. Attorney requests review of property damage and rental vehicle costs in addition to bodily injury. Advised that rental coverage is under insured's policy and will be reviewed against liability findings. Diary set for follow-up after therapy records are received.

Entry 5: Liability position updated to reflect third party's admitted failure to yield. Reserves reviewed and adjusted for bodily injury and property damage. Supervisor notified. Claim remains open pending completion of medical treatment and receipt of updated billing from counsel.
